text: Data Business Analyst (H/F) LabelVie Casablanca et périphérie il y a 3 semaines Plus de 200 candidats Découvrez qui LabelVie a recruté pour ce poste Postuler Enregistrer - Signaler cette offre d’emploi Créé en 1986 et côté à la Bourse de Casablanca depuis 2008, le Groupe marocain LabelVie est un acteur économique de référence et leader de la grande distribution au Maroc. En 2009, à travers la signature du contrat de franchise avec le Groupe Carrefour, il accède à sa centrale d’achat pour optimiser et diversifier son sourcing. Il devient ainsi le premier acteur multi-formats de la grande distribution au Maroc par l’exploitation des hypermarchés Carrefour, des supermarchés Carrefour Market et du format hyper cash Atacadao. Le Groupe LabelVie présente chaque année un plan de développement soutenu renforçant sa présence territoriale avec ses 136 magasins répartis dans 28 villes du royaume et ses 3 plateformes logistiques et un chiffre d’affaires réalisé de 11,7 milliards de dirhams en 2021. En 2021, le Groupe LabelVie a entamé sa transformation digitale afin de répondre aux enjeux d’innovation et aux besoins des consommateurs finaux. Negotiation and Communication: Strong negotiation and communication skills are paramount. Language Proficiency: Excellent command of Spanish is required. Microsoft Office Proficiency: Proficient in the Microsoft Office suite, with an emphasis on Excel skills. text: Job : Join a dynamic company in the Energy sector as a Senior Business Developer , based in Casablanca , Morocco. This is a unique opportunity to actively contribute to the development of our market presence while working in a stimulating and innovative environment. Your role will be to identify and secure new business opportunities, grow our client portfolio, and strengthen our strategic positioning. You will be a key player in achieving our growth objectives and expanding our commercial activities. Your main responsibilities will include: • Define and implement an aggressive prospecting strategy across the entire Moroccan market. • Identify and qualify new clients in both public and private sectors. • Develop a network of decision-makers and open new strategic accounts. • Identify projects early, before tenders are released. • Organize and conduct sales meetings with decision-makers. • Understand client needs and build suitable solutions with technical teams. • Manage the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to contract signing. • Participate in the development of technical and commercial proposals. • Negotiate commercial and contractual terms. • Provide regular reporting to Management. • Represent BUTEC at professional events and maintain ongoing market intelligence. Required profile : You hold a degree in Electrical Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Energy Engineering, Civil Engineering, or equivalent. With a minimum of 5 to 8 years of experience in B2B business development, including essential experience in the multi-technical maintenance, Facility Management, or technical services sector. To excel in this role, it is essential to have: • Excellent knowledge of multi-technical maintenance professions. • Good understanding of Facility Management contracts. • Mastery of public and private tenders. • Strong negotiation skills. • Strategic vision for business development. • Strong ability to open new accounts. • Excellent ability to convince decision-makers. • Results-oriented mindset. • Enjoyment of challenges. • Drive for developing new business.
